purpose: Public operating contract for core Moral Trade security headers, private-cache controls, rate-limit surfaces, email-outbox safety gates, retention lifecycle controls, observability metrics, fallback behavior, and rollout gates.

securityHeaders.label: Strict Transport Security
securityHeaders.evidence: next.config.ts sets Strict-Transport-Security for all routes.

securityHeaders.label: Permissions policy
securityHeaders.evidence: next.config.ts disables camera, microphone, geolocation, and payment.

securityHeaders.label: Private route no-store
securityHeaders.evidence: Private dashboard, admin, profile API, and job API routes get private no-store headers.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Supabase auth cookies
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: src/lib/supabase/proxy.ts refreshes auth claims through server-side cookies.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Private route cache control
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: Private route prefixes receive Cache-Control: private, no-store.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Data-right request lane
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: Profile data-right requests validate destructive/corrective details and due dates.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Field-level disclosure grants
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: Background networking grants stage public previews, detail requests, and mutual consent.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Email outbox safety gate
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: src/lib/moral-trade/email-copy.ts centralizes generic dashboard-directed Moral Trade email copy and src/app/api/jobs/email/route.ts suppresses unsafe rows before provider send when body text contains contact details, exact offer terms, payment amounts, agreement or payment identifiers, evidence, raw source notes, or private wish markers.

privacyAndSessionControls.label: Audit events
privacyAndSessionControls.evidence: Match, privacy, and admin actions record audit events where disclosure is safe.

retentionControls.label: Account and profile lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Authenticated account records, opt-in public profiles, profile export/import records, and profile portability schema metadata.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Kept while the account, public profile, or review record needs it; export, correction, deletion, and restriction requests must route through authenticated dashboard or privacy support lanes.
retentionControls.evidence: src/app/privacy/page.tsx publishes account/profile retention and src/app/api/profile/export plus src/app/api/profile/import use private no-store profile portability APIs.

retentionControls.label: Private wish and source lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Private wishes, source summaries, approved source-derived profile signals, matching preferences, and consent-gated background-networking inputs.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Kept only for the consent scope or review workflow that needs it; expired or revoked source summaries and profile signals stop affecting matching, and exact wishes, raw source text, source notes, and shadow-run drafts remain excluded from public cards, analytics, public contract routes, and search previews.
retentionControls.evidence: Data-model and disclosure contracts require field-level grants, stage scope, expiry, and private/public boundaries before disclosure.

retentionControls.label: Evidence and provenance lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Evidence metadata, reviewer decisions, state-transition event records, and append-only provenance activities.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Append-only review/provenance records are retained for audit integrity; corrections append new activities rather than mutating prior records, and raw evidence artifacts are excluded from public APIs.
retentionControls.evidence: Provenance contract publishes append-only persistence tables, correction rules, sample bundle summaries, and raw-artifact exclusion.

retentionControls.label: Payment and donation reference lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Stripe payment identifiers, donation-route handoff references, payment status, amount, cadence, and review evidence notes.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Retained only where reconciliation, dispute handling, audit integrity, or compliance needs require it; public routes must not claim custody, escrow, or guarantee payment protection.
retentionControls.evidence: Privacy and terms pages publish payment/donation processor boundaries and non-custody claims.

retentionControls.label: Analytics and attribution lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Approved funnel event type, route path, coarse metadata buckets, partner attribution, and optional authenticated profile id.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Only redacted funnel records are eligible for storage; exact wishes, contact details, report bodies, raw source notes, private evidence artifacts, and free-form payloads are excluded before insert. Browser-level opt-out clears attribution and suppresses optional funnel-event inserts.
retentionControls.evidence: src/lib/measurement-plan.ts defines approved events and analytics-objection guardrails; src/lib/growth.ts builds privacy-safe funnel event records and names the opt-out cookie.

retentionControls.label: Notification delivery lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Email/in-app delivery rows, digest preferences, quiet-hour windows, source cooldown state, opt-out state, suppression status, and failed-delivery diagnostics.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Preference rows and delivery records are retained to honor opt-outs, enforce discovery cooldowns, diagnose failed or suppressed delivery, and avoid exposing private wish text, contact details, exact terms, payment amounts, agreement IDs, evidence, or source notes in notifications.
retentionControls.evidence: Privacy page publishes notification processor boundaries and notification retention purpose; email-copy tests cover generic copy and sender-side suppression before provider delivery.

retentionControls.label: Data-right request lifecycle
retentionControls.scope: Access, correction, deletion, restriction, and processor-clarification requests.
retentionControls.retentionWindow: Requests keep the minimum status, request type, due date, requester scope, and resolution metadata needed to complete and audit the rights lane; destructive or corrective details must remain private no-store.
retentionControls.evidence: Privacy, terms, dashboard, and privacy_access_requests actions expose access/correction/deletion/restriction request lanes.

fallbackControls.label: Deterministic/manual fallback
fallbackControls.rule: If copilot, provider, or evidence tooling fails, keep deterministic validation and manual review available.

fallbackControls.label: Invalid copilot output cannot change state
fallbackControls.rule: Invalid or timed-out copilot output must not publish, match, disclose, or complete a proposal.

fallbackControls.label: Provider timeout cannot change state
fallbackControls.rule: Provider or payment/evidence timeouts remain pending or manual-review states.

fallbackControls.label: Unsafe email rows cannot reach the provider
fallbackControls.rule: Core Moral Trade email outbox rows with contact details, exact offer terms, payment amounts, agreement or payment identifiers, evidence, raw source notes, or private wish markers are marked suppressed before provider send.

fallbackControls.label: Replay-safe state transitions
fallbackControls.rule: State transitions should be idempotent, auditable, and safe to retry.

rolloutGates.label: Shadow mode first
rolloutGates.rule: Copilot critiques and reviewer summaries do not control live decisions.

rolloutGates.label: Assist mode requires human approval
rolloutGates.rule: Field prefill and factor-code suggestions require human approval for status changes.

rolloutGates.label: Guarded automation only for low-risk tasks
rolloutGates.rule: Only missing-field detection, explanation rendering, and evidence checklist drafting may be automated.

rolloutGates.label: Safety decisions stay human-controlled
rolloutGates.rule: Safety blocking, matching disclosure, reviewed completion, and dispute resolution remain human-controlled.
